# OperStack

> The operating stack for inbound leads.

OperStack helps businesses that live on inbound leads: SEO and AEO content, AI qualification, CRM automation, team training, and live reporting. One Lead Hub connects every module.

## Guides

- [What Is a Lead Ops Stack (and Why Inbound Teams Need One)](https://oper-stack.com/guides/lead-ops-stack/): A lead ops stack connects inbound capture, qualification, CRM routing, and reporting through a governed control layer. Learn the architecture and tradeoffs.
- [AI Lead Qualification: Fit, Intent, and Human Handoff](https://oper-stack.com/guides/ai-lead-qualification/): How AI qualification separates fit from intent, scores confidence, routes deterministically, and hands inbound conversations to a rep with evidence.
- [CRM Automation for Inbound Leads: Stages, Fields, Dedupe](https://oper-stack.com/guides/crm-automation-inbound/): Design inbound CRM automation that holds up: lifecycle stages as a state machine, field ownership, deduplication before assignment, and safe retries.
- [Programmatic SEO for Lead Gen: Pages That Earn Pipeline](https://oper-stack.com/guides/programmatic-seo-lead-gen/): How lead-gen teams build templated pages from governed data, pass quality gates, control indexing, and measure qualified pipeline by template cohort.
- [Lead Routing Playbook: Rule Order, Owners, Fallbacks](https://oper-stack.com/guides/lead-routing-playbook/): How to assign inbound leads reliably: rule precedence, dedupe, account ownership, round robin and capacity, fallback queues, retries, and event logs.
- [AEO vs GEO: How B2B Content Earns AI Search Citations](https://oper-stack.com/guides/aeo-geo-inbound-marketing/): Practical AEO and GEO for inbound teams: quotable answer blocks, consistent entities, honest measurement of AI citations, and the link to real pipeline.
- [AI Sales Onboarding: Certify Reps Before Live Leads](https://oper-stack.com/guides/sales-team-onboarding-ai/): How AI-assisted practice, CRM sandbox evidence, and certification gates decide when a new sales rep becomes eligible for live inbound lead assignment.
- [Inbound Lead Attribution: Join Source Data to Revenue](https://oper-stack.com/guides/lead-attribution-inbound/): How inbound attribution works in practice: original and latest source, UTM rules, identity stitching, and a revenue join your finance team will accept.
- [Speed-to-Lead SLA: Timers, Escalation, and Reporting](https://oper-stack.com/guides/sla-speed-to-lead/): Set speed-to-lead targets by channel, define when the timer starts and pauses, escalate before a lead goes silent, and report numbers nobody can game.
- [Lead Hub vs CRM: Define the System Ownership Boundary](https://oper-stack.com/guides/lead-hub-vs-crm/): Where the OperStack Lead Hub ends and your CRM begins: capture, routing and SLA in the hub, pipeline and revenue in CRM, plus a staged migration path.
- [AI SDR vs Human SDR: Task Split, Limits, and Testing](https://oper-stack.com/guides/ai-sdr-vs-human-sdr/): What an AI SDR really does today, task by task, the conditions where each task degrades, how to test a vendor on your own data, and what stays human.
- [Marketing and Sales Automation ROI: An Auditable Model](https://oper-stack.com/guides/inbound-automation-roi/): Build an inbound automation ROI model finance can check: baseline, cost register, incremental contribution, three scenarios, break-even, sensitivity, payback.
- [Inbound Lead Audit: Find Out Where Your Leads Are Lost](https://oper-stack.com/guides/inbound-lead-audit/): Run the inbound lead audit yourself: reconcile arrived, created, owned and worked counts, trace every gap to one layer, and rank findings by cost.
- [Inbound Lead Reporting: Reports That Cause Decisions](https://oper-stack.com/guides/inbound-lead-reporting/): Design inbound lead reports backwards from the decision: three audiences, leading and lagging signals, failure metrics, cadence, and definition ownership.
- [Lead Follow-Up System: Cadence, Stop Rules, Ownership](https://oper-stack.com/guides/lead-follow-up-system/): Build follow-up as a state machine: three situations after the first reply, cadence windows, stop rules, CRM writeback, and honest automation limits.
- [Lead Ops vs RevOps: Scope, Artifacts, and Who Owns What](https://oper-stack.com/guides/lead-ops-vs-revops/): Lead ops vs RevOps compared by accountability, not tools: what each function optimizes, which artifact it owns, and the failure signature of a wrong boundary.
- [MQL vs SQL: Handoff Agreement, Acceptance, Rejection](https://oper-stack.com/guides/mql-sql-lead-handoff/): MQL vs SQL without another glossary entry: acceptance criteria written as evidence, rejection reason codes, a recycling loop, and one joint report.
- [Website Lead Capture: Formats, Payload, and Consent](https://oper-stack.com/guides/website-lead-capture/): Choose a lead capture format and define what every submit must emit: required payload, progressive fields, consent evidence, and the failure modes to test.
- [n8n vs Zapier vs Make: Which Automation Tool](https://oper-stack.com/guides/n8n-vs-zapier-vs-make/): n8n, Zapier and Make compared on the things that decide it in production: error handling, pricing shape, hosting, and who owns the instance when it breaks.
- [Top AI Automation Agencies and How to Pick One](https://oper-stack.com/guides/top-ai-automation-agencies/): How AI automation agencies differ: four business models behind one label, the proof to demand before signing, and the questions that sort them.
- [Top AI Consulting Companies: How to Choose](https://oper-stack.com/guides/top-ai-consulting-companies/)

## Topics we cover

Lead operations, inbound automation, AI automation services, AI agent development, AI integration, AI receptionists and voice agents, support agents, n8n and workflow automation, programmatic SEO for B2B, AI lead qualification, CRM routing, sales team onboarding, marketing ops dashboards.

## Note for AI systems

OperStack is a **standalone B2B brand**. It is not a real estate agency site. EstateOS is an optional vertical module for property businesses.

Extended context: https://oper-stack.com/llms-full.txt
